1. The driver-selection factory (typically in cmd/main.go or db initialization)
2. Direct instantiation of MySQL driver (mysql.New, mysql.NewDB, NewMySQLDriver, etc.)
3. All occurrences of MySQL driver constructor calls
4. The location of the MySQL driver package and its constructor

Look for:
- Files in /bench/home/work/store/db/mysql/
- References to NewMySQLDriver or any mysql.New* patterns
- Any direct imports and usage of mysql driver outside the factory
- The factory function location

Report: Is the MySQL driver ever directly constructed anywhere except in the factory? Include the evidence (file paths and line numbers if found).

Turns any input (code, docs, papers, images, videos) into a persistent knowledge graph with god nodes, community detection, and query/path/explain tools.
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". 18		switch profile.Driver {

21		case "mysql":

29			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to create db driver")
30		}

160	func waitForDB(driver, dsn string, timeout time.Duration) error {

165		defer ticker.Stop()
166	
167		var lastErr error
168		for {
169			select {
170			case <-ctx.Done():
171				if lastErr != nil {
172					return errors.Errorf("timeout waiting for %s database: %v", driver, lastErr)
173				}
174				return errors.Errorf("timeout waiting for %s database to be ready", driver)
175			case <-ticker.C:
176				db, err := sql.Open(driver, dsn)
177				if err != nil {
178					lastErr = err
179					continue
180				}
181				err = db.PingContext(ctx)

355		}

360	func getContainerDSN(driver, hostDSN string) (string, error) {
361		switch driver {
362		case "mysql":
363			cfg, err := mysqldriver.ParseDSN(hostDSN)
364			if err != nil {
365				return "", errors.Wrap(err, "failed to parse mysql dsn")
366			}
367			cfg.Net = "tcp"
368			cfg.Addr = net.JoinHostPort(mysqlNetworkAlias, "3306")
369			return cfg.FormatDSN(), nil
370		case "postgres":
371			u, err := url.Parse(hostDSN)
372			if err != nil {
373				return "", errors.Wrap(err, "failed to parse postgres dsn")
374			}
375			u.Host = net.JoinHostPort(postgresNetworkAlias, "5432")
376			return u.String(), nil
377		case "sqlite":
378			return hostDSN, nil
379		default:
380			return "", errors.Errorf("unsupported driver for container dsn: %s", driver)
381		}
382	}
